text:
marta: Ran nightly cont-batcher stress on mosaic-8k-q4 (q4f16 int8) across APAC/EU for 2h. APAC tail lat jumps after ~45m, throughput drops ~18%. Possible KV cache evictions. attaching perf snapshot.

lee: link? logs? :eyes: 

marta: https://console.redwood/bench/2179999999
bench-bot: snapshot posted below (see short summary)

bench-bot: Bench snapshot 2179999999 - mosaic-8k-q4 - apac-h100 vs eu-h100
APAC p95: 280ms -> 520ms after 45m
EU p95: 260ms -> 270ms
Throughput APAC: -18% after 45m
Logs: /var/log/serving/bench-2179.log

samir: do we have eviction counts / mem pressure metrics?

marta: eviction metrics: `kv_cache_evictions: 430` after spike. mem_free stable. saw `gc_pause_ms` spikes (20-60ms).

lee: hmm. scheduler changes or kernel differences? any config diffs (batch window / warmup)?

marta: same config across regions: `batch_window_ms: 6`, `max_batch_tokens: 2048`, `reserve_kv: false`. No warmup change.

yara: try enabling `reserve_kv` for APAC canary, or bump `cache_ttl`. also check kernel version — APAC ran `matmul-opt-v2` vs EU `matmul-opt-v1`.

marta: good catch — APAC job used kernel `matmul-opt-v2` (custom perf build).

samir: that could change KV layout / eviction behavior. can reproduce locally: `toxbench --seed 42 --region apac --kernel matmul-opt-v2 --workload contbatcher-stress`

lee: can we repro with continuous batching off (force single-token batching)?

marta: quick A/B: disabled contbatcher on one node -> tail spikes gone. so contbatcher+kernel combo increases KV churn under sustained load.

bench-bot: Created incident stub INC-2026-0317-2179, assigned to eng-ml.

yara: proposed plan:
1) Canary APAC with `reserve_kv=true` + `cache_ttl=120s` (5% traffic)
2) Run 1h stress, monitor p95/p99 and eviction counts
3) If stable, gate kernel rollout with kernel-compatibility check in rollout pipeline

marta: Canary started: https://console.redwood/canaries/2179999999. will post updates in ~30m.

lee: if canary fails, fallback APAC to `matmul-opt-v1` and pause rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout monitor: canary created, traffic 5% APAC -> 1 node, watch p95.

marta: :thumbsup: Will update with metrics.

yara: also add a short eval to check generation quality difference between kernels (quick perplexity/ROUGE spot check) before mass rollout.

marta: noted — starting quality eval now.

lee: thanks, team.
